availability: Only completed current bars, prior completed regular-session close, current session open, and exchange-calendar time are used; no future price values.

definitions.closeLocation: (close_t - low_t) / (high_t - low_t), or 0.5 when high_t == low_t
definitions.openingGapPct: current regular-session open / previous complete regular-session close - 1
definitions.sessionProgress: bounded (current bar start - session open) / (session close - session open)
